topography.project_purpose: RWA. Structurally: 98 project-authored contract(s) across 4 chain(s); 8 ERC4626 vaults, 14 ERC20 tokens, 2 Chainlink feeds; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 6 functional families. Its contracts share 27 common project-authored base contract(s) (accesscontroldefaultadminrulesupgradeable, accesscontrolupgradeable, contextupgradeable). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
